issues.explanation: The conjunctive form is read いき, not the dictionary-form reading いく.
This is the conditional form 帰れ, read かえれ.
The conjunctive form is read こもり, not こもる.
The stem in 描かず is read えがか.
The stem in 効かない is read きか.
The continuative form is read やめ, not やめる.
The stem in 休まず is read やすま.
The conjunctive form is read かよい, not かよう.
The conjunctive form is read うたい, not うたう.
The conjunctive form of つく is read つき.
The stem in 食わない is read くわ.
The stem in 太らない is read ふとら.
Here で is the conjunctive form of the copula だ, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate で as an auxiliary with lemma だ.

issues.explanation: The stem in ならず is read なら.
The stem in 捕らず is read とら.
The continuative form is read つけ, not つける.
もらえない here is the negative potential form of もらえる, not an inflected form of もらう.
issues.suggested_fix: Use lemma もらえる, kana もらえ, and annotate it as an auxiliary expressing ability to receive a favor.

issues.explanation: In 付けてもらえない, もらえ is the benefactive auxiliary, not an ordinary independent word.
The conditional form of 言う is read いえ.
きりがない is a genuine fixed expression meaning “there is no end/limit.”
issues.suggested_fix: Keep きりがない together as a fixed idiom, with an idiomatic meaning such as “there would be no end to it.”

issues.explanation: In きりがない, ない is the lexical predicate meaning “not exist/no,” not the auxiliary negative.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate it as a word/adjective with lemma ない.

issues.explanation: The で in つもりである is the conjunctive copula, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate で as an auxiliary with lemma だ.
